item.title: Tennessee’s Andy Ogles Faces Well-Funded Opposition in House Primary Thursday

item.title: Moderate Democrats Prepare for ‘War’ Against an Ascendant Left

item.title: A Trans Woman Brandished a Firearm. Gun Rights Devotion Disappeared.
item.description: Gun-friendly Wyoming has a “stand your ground” statute that allows people to use force to defend themselves. So why is a trans woman being prosecuted after being shoved to the ground?
item.dc:creator: Jack Healy
item.media:credit: Daniel Brenner for The New York Times
item.media:description: “I had to defend myself,” said Rihanna Kelver, who pulled out a gun outside the Crowbar & Grill in Laramie, Wyo.

item.title: Where Election Deniers Are County Election Officials

item.title: In Texas’ Most Eligible Senate Race, It’s Bachelor vs. Divorcé-to-Be

item.title: Federal Judge Weakens The National Firearms Act
item.description: The National Firearms Act mandated a permitting process for short-barreled rifles and shotguns, as well as suppressors. A judge ruled that the provision was unconstitutional.

Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives

item.media:description: A visitor points to firearms at an exhibition booth during the National Rifle Association’s annual meeting and exhibit in Houston this year. The two lower rifles are outfitted with suppressors.

item.title: Mayor Says El-Sayed’s Win Shows He Is More Than a ‘Mini-Mamdani’

item.media:description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani of New York last month at Gracie Mansion in Manhattan. Mr. Mamdani was asked on Wednesday about similarities between him and Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, who won Michigan’s Democratic Senate primary.

item.title: C.I.A. Sets Up Secret Cuba Task Force as Trump Pressures Havana

item.title: Helicopter Carrying Trump Flew Near Passenger Jet in Washington Airspace

item.media:credit: Antranik Tavitian for The New York Times
